subject: P03
required_fixes: R1 [medium, cross-feature context isolation] Retire the Library-to-Playground handoff and pending save UI with their originating ContextRef. desktop-shell.tsx:55-56 keeps an unscoped prefill and clears it only in a passive effect; :203 renders an unkeyed RuntimeView. runtime-view.tsx:47-53 clears only messages/selection, retaining caseName and savingCase, and :81-84 accepts a delayed save admission without rechecking its context. Independent in-memory probes of the actual DesktopShell and RuntimeView reproduced: load A's case, render tenant B, and B's first committed frame still contains A's loaded banner and private prompt; after effects the prompt clears but A's case name remains. Holding A's SaveCase admission across that transition and then resolving it also shows 'Saving to this tenant’s case Library' under B. Rust context checks do not retire this presentation state. Acceptance: bind loaded-case and save state/callbacks to their originating context and gate them synchronously during rendering; do not rely solely on effect cleanup. Add a production App/Shell regression covering tenant switch and credential-context replacement while Playground remains mounted, including a delayed old save admission. No committed B view may contain A's loaded-case fields/name/banner or receive A's save status; returning to A must not revive retired handoffs. Preserve explicit case copy and normal same-context loading/saving.
limitations: P03's Rust integration retains the intended authority boundaries: separate scan/management credentials, context retirement for management reads, shared Runtime/DLP review and native confirmation authority, one-time secret ownership, credential-scoped investigations, tenant-scoped reports/libraries and coordinated cleanup/reset. Academy identity and shared presentation remain separate from tenant operations. The remaining finding concerns the frontend composition of Library and Playground.
